slides.title: Planning How Evidence Reaches the World
bullets: Organizes in advance how and when evidence is communicated scientifically
Covers peer-reviewed articles, congress presentations, and other formal formats
Builds the body of evidence that sustains long-term product credibility

slides.title: From Evidence Inventory to Journal Choice
bullets: Starts with an inventory of all available and in-development evidence
Trials, observational studies, RWE analyses, investigator-initiated research
Prioritizes journals and congresses by clinical relevance, audience, and impact
The literature favors surgically selected high-impact outlets over sheer volume

slides.title: A Coordinated Publication Timeline
bullets: Aligns publication timing with launches, congresses, and regulatory milestones
No publication should be delayed unnecessarily
None should be rushed in a way that compromises peer-review rigor

slides.title: Good Publication Practice Standards
bullets: Respect genuine academic authorship at every step
Full transparency on funding and the sponsoring company's role
Publish results regardless of whether they favor the product
Directly combats the publication bias covered in an earlier module

slides.title: A Bridge Before and After Publication
bullets: Rarely an author, but brings field knowledge of what will resonate locally
Helps published content reach the right HCPs with the right context
Never distributes content ahead of official publication or embargo policy

slides.title: Turning Evidence into Public Knowledge
bullets: A publication plan is not an end in itself
It's the mechanism that turns generated evidence into public, citable knowledge
Available to the whole scientific community, not just those with company access

takeaway.title: The publication plan turns generated evidence into credible, public scientific knowledge
bullets: Journal and congress choice is prioritized by relevance, not volume
Good Publication Practice standards protect authorship and transparency
The MSL bridges field insight into the plan and context back out to HCPs
